purpose: Central approval register for public quantitative, licensing, confidentiality, testimonial, result, response-time, and service-scope claims.
policy: Only approved wording may be used in public copy. Every claim requires an evidence owner, evidence location, jurisdiction scope, verification date, review expiry, and any required qualification.
experiencePresentationPolicy: Owner direction, 2026-11-03: describe CounselO's experience through the legal team's expertise and the specific legal work offered. Keep Omar Al-Baghdadi's personal career dates and credentials in founder biographies and professional attribution. Do not transfer his career duration, matter counts or outcomes to the team or platform. Apply the same distinction in Arabic and English.

claims.approvedWordingEn: Clients across the region trust CounselO for online legal support.
claims.approvedWordingAr: يثق عملاء في أنحاء المنطقة بكاونسلو للحصول على الدعم القانوني أونلاين.
claims.evidenceLocation: Owner statement in the 2026-11-03 website-copy request: trusted by many customers across the region. Owner attestation only; no independent survey or review dataset supplied.
claims.requiredDisclaimer: Keep as a general owner-attested client relationship claim. Do not imply a measured satisfaction rate, client count, rating, independent endorsement, market ranking or guaranteed outcome.

claims.approvedWordingEn: CounselO targets a professional response within 24 hours, subject to the matter's scope, urgency, intake completeness, and service availability.
claims.approvedWordingAr: تستهدف كاونسلو تقديم رد مهني خلال 24 ساعة، بحسب نطاق المسألة ودرجة الاستعجال واكتمال المعلومات وتوفر الخدمة.
claims.evidenceLocation: Contact intake logs and notification delivery records
claims.requiredDisclaimer: A target is not a guarantee; urgent or incomplete matters may require a different response path.

claims.approvedWordingEn: Information is handled confidentially under applicable professional, contractual, privacy, and data-protection obligations, subject to legally required or permitted disclosures.
claims.approvedWordingAr: تُعامل المعلومات بسرية وفق الالتزامات المهنية والتعاقدية وواجبات الخصوصية وحماية البيانات المنطبقة، مع مراعاة الإفصاحات التي يوجبها القانون أو يسمح بها.
claims.evidenceLocation: Privacy policy, consultation terms, encrypted contact payload and access controls
claims.requiredDisclaimer: Do not state that information is never shared or that privilege applies identically in every jurisdiction.

claims.approvedWordingEn: CounselO provides online consultation, document review, preliminary analysis, and written guidance. If court representation is requested or necessary, it can be arranged through an appropriately licensed partner professional or cooperating office in the relevant served jurisdiction under a separate agreed engagement.
claims.approvedWordingAr: تقدم كاونسلو الاستشارات الأونلاين ومراجعة المستندات والتحليل الأولي والإرشاد المكتوب. وإذا طُلب التمثيل أمام المحاكم أو أصبح ضرورياً، يمكن ترتيبه من خلال مهني شريك أو مكتب متعاون مرخص في الدولة المعنية بموجب تكليف مستقل متفق عليه.
claims.evidenceLocation: Terms of service, regional service pages, cooperating-office records
claims.requiredDisclaimer: Formal representation is not implied by an online consultation and is confirmed only in an agreed engagement.

claims.evidenceLocation: Matter and consultation archive with deduplication methodology
claims.requiredDisclaimer: Use only with its personal career attribution in founder-profile context, not as a team or platform total, an independently audited result or a guarantee of outcome.

claims.evidenceLocation: Approved professional biography and verified professional-start record dated 1996
claims.requiredDisclaimer: Derived from Omar Al-Baghdadi's professional-start year of 1996 and limited to his biography. Do not use as the team's tenure or the platform's age, or imply jurisdiction-specific licensing or court rights.

claims.approvedWordingEn: Omar Al-Baghdadi states that he has trained or supervised more than 40 lawyers.
claims.approvedWordingAr: يذكر عمر البغدادي أنه درّب أو أشرف على أكثر من 40 محامياً.
claims.requiredDisclaimer: Do not convert this figure into a licensing, expertise, or outcome guarantee.

claims.approvedWordingEn: Where local licensing or physical attendance is required, CounselO identifies and separately scopes coordination with an appropriately licensed professional or cooperating office.
claims.approvedWordingAr: عند الحاجة إلى ترخيص محلي أو حضور فعلي، تحدد كاونسلو التنسيق مع مهني أو مكتب متعاون مرخّص بشكل مناسب وتفصل نطاقه.
claims.requiredDisclaimer: Never imply that CounselO or an individual is locally licensed unless the relevant licence and jurisdiction are verified in the register.

claims.approvedWordingEn: Published work samples are redacted and illustrative; past work, stated outcomes, testimonials, and timelines do not guarantee the result of another matter.
claims.approvedWordingAr: نماذج الأعمال المنشورة منقحة وتوضيحية؛ ولا تضمن الأعمال السابقة أو النتائج أو الشهادات أو المدد نتيجة أي مسألة أخرى.
claims.evidenceLocation: Redacted work approval record and source case file
claims.requiredDisclaimer: Precise financial recovery, reversal, success, or timeline claims require a linked verified case record and approval before publication.
